sections.text: Selpercatinib is US-approved for adults with locally advanced or metastatic RET-fusion-positive NSCLC. From age 2 years, separate indications cover advanced RET-fusion-positive thyroid cancer requiring systemic therapy and radioactive-iodine-refractory disease when appropriate, and other advanced RET-fusion-positive solid tumors after prior treatment or without satisfactory alternatives.

CCDC6::RET is a recurrent RET rearrangement documented in lung cancer cohorts. Reported breakpoints retain the RET kinase-containing carboxy-terminal region. Selpercatinib is US-approved for adults with locally advanced or metastatic RET-fusion-positive NSCLC. From age 2 years, separate indications cover advanced RET-fusion-positive thyroid cancer requiring systemic therapy and radioactive-iodine-refractory disease when appropriate, and other advanced RET-fusion-positive solid tumors after prior treatment or without satisfactory alternatives.
